prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os Santos enchiam todos os seus momentos de boas obras e de grandes ações.

meta.face: A Magyar of about fifty, very tall and strongly built, with a fair, sun-warmed complexion and a LONG, HEXAGONAL face — a high, straight forehead, HIGH, ANGULAR cheekbones, the sides of the face falling STRAIGHT to a long jaw; a LONG, perfectly STRAIGHT, narrow nose whose high bridge runs in one line from the brow; LARGE, WIDE-OPEN, almond-shaped light-brown eyes under HIGH, clearly ARCHED brows; a long upper lip under a DROOPING moustache; a long, full, dark-blond beard CURLED and PARTED into TWO POINTS below the chin; thick dark-blond hair ROLLED in heavy curls at the sides and falling to the collar; the gaze open and steady, straight ahead.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives. His reliquary bust at Győr (Wikipedia's lead image; the face may follow Béla III, a descendant) shows a long face with a long straight nose, large open eyes, a drooping moustache, a curled, forked beard and rolled locks; the Hungarian Wikipedia cites the sources' 'strong, huge-bodied man, standing a shoulder above the others', and art gives him the battle-axe. The book tells the king compelled to the throne in 1080, austere, just and merciful, who drove out the invaders and died in 1095 preparing for the Crusade.
